_source: Platform wiring. Fill these in when the client's accounts exist; everything falls back to offline behavior while they are empty.

steam._note: The client's Steamworks App ID. 0 means Steam is off. For local testing with the Steam client running, 480 (Valve's Spacewar test app) works with GodotSteam.

base44._app_id_note: The repo's docs name 6a60f218b0c6605c92fa35c4 as the live app; this one is the app the client built Elio in. The client picks which one the game talks to.
base44._note: The site's entities need a logged-in session (public reads return 403), so the game talks to two small Base44 backend functions the client adds: gameMarketItems (returns MarketItem rows) and gameLinkAccount (turns a one-time code from the site into an account id). Empty functions_base_url = use data/market_sample.json and offline accounts. No service token ever goes in the game build.

market._note: The canon client is offline-first with no links out, and the market's phrasing law never names the site in-world. Set true to show a quiet 'where it travels' button on PC builds; consoles never show it.
